PZZ700-030915-
1213 PM PST Mon Nov 2 2026

.Synopsis for the far Southern CA coast...
At 12 PM, a 1022 mb high was 500 miles west of San Diego and a 
1012 mb low was over the southwest United States. Weak offshore 
flow in the mornings will alternate with afternoon onshore flow 
through Friday. Increased northwest winds are expected Tuesday
afternoon into Wednesday morning with gusts of 20 to 25 kt in the
Outer Coastal waters. A Small Craft Advisory is in effect for the
Outer Coastal Waters. 

$$
